name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Permanent Runtz
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. Permanent Marker x Cherry Pie combine to create Permanent Cherries, a balanced hybrid that blends euphoric mental effects with a smooth, calming body high. Its sweet cherry and floral aroma with a herbal finish comes from Myrcene, Linalool, and Caryophyllene. Great for both daytime balance or evening ease, it’s a versatile option.
